Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他需要当上医：医生
- 一看别的人就想帮助他们：看到，看look vs.看到see; 病人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：吃了以后
- 神农三个月走去：走了三个月

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，“古代的时候” is not the standard time expression here; use “在古代” to introduce the historical setting.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 当上医：当上医生，“医” is not normally used alone after “当上” in this context; “医生” is the ordinary noun for a person who treats patients.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别的人：病人，“别的人” means people other than a previously specified person or group. Here the intended meaning is people who need medical treatment, so “病人” fits.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个远远的地方：一个很远的地方，“远远的” is usually used adverbially, while “很远的” naturally describes a distant place.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好：不管什么病人吃了，都会觉得身体好多了，Use “不管……都……” for a universal condition. “了” marks eating the plant as completed before the result, and “好多了” clearly expresses an improvement in health.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 三个月走去：走了三个月，A duration phrase follows the verb, as in “走了三个月”; “走去” also normally needs a destination when it means walking somewhere.
7. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个很漂亮的植物：一株很漂亮的植物，“株” is the appropriate measure word for an individual plant.
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 有植物的地方：有这种植物的地方，Use “这种植物” to refer back clearly to the plant mentioned in the previous sentence; “有植物” could mean a place with any kind of plant.
9. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农走了三个月：他走了三个月，Use a pronoun for a close re-occurrence when the name was used in the immediately preceding sentence and no other character competes as the referent.
10. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 找到有这种植物的地方：找到了有这种植物的地方，Use “了” for the completed action of finding the place.

items.reason: “古代” already expresses a time period, so adding “的时候” is redundant under the teacher's rule.
“医” cannot stand alone here for the profession; “医生” is correct.
The intended people are patients, whereas “别人” means other people distinct from a specified person or group.
“一个远远的地方” is acceptable Chinese, although “一个很远的地方” is a more ordinary alternative.
The correction omits the plant object and does not form the needed “吃了……以后” structure, so “什么病人吃了” is not a correct repair.
A duration belongs after the verb here, and “走了三个月” correctly expresses the completed journey duration.
“个” is a permissible general measure word for a plant, though “株” is more specific.
“这种植物” clearly refers back to the particular plant that Shennong heard about.
Under the teacher's close re-occurrence rule, “他” should replace the immediately repeated name.
Finding the place is a completed narrative action, so “找到了” is correct.
